best

messages.subject: Help with INLA installation/usage issues
parts:
Dear R-INLA community,

I am trying to use the INLA package for analysis, but I am encountering some difficulties. I am following the instructions on https://www.r-inla.org/download-install, but I keep running into the same error. The error message I receive is:

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  The inla result collection failed.
The inla result collection failed

I am trying to run the model using an example from https://ourcodingclub.github.io/tutorials/inla/.

Could someone help me understand what is happening and how to resolve this issue?

Thank you very much for your support.

Best regards
Elvira
